messages:
zoe: Heads-up: found a determinisitic repro where edge bundles (vite/rollup/webpack) strip Authorization on SDK retry only when package exports use conditional ESM fields + TS types that reference global Request. Repro attached.

alejandro: interesting. does it happen for both GET and POST?
zoe: GET and POST with buffered JSON bodies. Steps: 1) git clone https://example/repro-edge-auth-2 2) npm ci 3) npm run build:edge:vite 4) npm run serve:edge 5) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer T" http://localhost:8787/api/proxy -> first proxied call 200, then SDK retry 401/403.
ravi: any hint in built output?
zoe: yes: when the bundler resolves the ESM export it sometimes emits an interop helper that reconstructs a Request via: 
new Request(req.url, req)
That relies on enumerable properties on req. Our edge fetch shim + some polyfills make headers non-enumerable so Authorization disappears. In CJS output the original req.clone() call remains intact.
alejandro: did you try changing TS types or import style?
zoe: namespace import (import * as SDK from 'redwood-sdk') changes how Rollup emits interop helpers and sometimes avoids the new Request path but it's not reliable across plugin sets. Also noticed a typing-only shim in our TS build that declared `clone(): Request` on the interface, which made terser think clone was unused and tree-shake it.
ravi: what's the proposed fix?
zoe: short-term: defensive SDK change using safeClone that prefers req.clone() and falls back to copying headers explicitly (preserves Authorization). Example: 
function safeClone(req){
  if (typeof req.clone === 'function') return req.clone();
  const headers = new Headers();
  for (const [k,v] of (req.headers||[])) headers.set(k,v);
  return new Request(req.url,{method:req.method,headers,body:req.body});
}
Applied to repro branch and it passes across Vite/Rollup/Webpack edge builds.
alejandro: file an issue and assign eng-runtime; also add a small integration test in CI matrix that builds with at least one edge bundler.
ravi: opened redwood/sdk#5001 with repro and branch. eng-bot: CI triggered.
eng-bot: Issue created: redwood/sdk#5001  assigned to @eng-runtime. CI matrix queued. :white_check_mark:
zoe: thanks. I'll follow up with a tiny docs blurb recommending the temporary import-style mitigation until the SDK patch ships.
